import os,sys
sys.path.insert(0,"src")
os.environ["QT_QPA_PLATFORM"]="offscreen"
import emo_master
from PySide2.QtWidgets import QApplication,QMessageBox
from PySide2.QtGui import QFontDatabase
from emo_master.apps.designer.main import applyDesignerStyle
app=QApplication([])
QFontDatabase.addApplicationFont("C:/Windows/Fonts/msyh.ttc")
applyDesignerStyle(app)
box=QMessageBox()
box.setText("Standalone message box, no project or Runtime")
box.addButton("Close",QMessageBox.RejectRole)
print("before show",flush=True)
box.show()
print("before processEvents",flush=True)
app.processEvents()
print("after processEvents",flush=True)
box.close()
